nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Main AppShell component composing the workstation chrome: top header, tab bar, tab header, status bar, and content area, wiring together all AppShell hooks.

nodes.name: AppShell
nodes.summary: Top-level memoized AppShell component that reads layout/session atoms, invokes the AppShell hooks (repo, dock, route sync, status bar, etc.), and renders the full workstation chrome around AppShellContent.

nodes.name: useWorkstationTabList.ts
nodes.summary: Hook building the derived list of open workstation tabs (with active/close/reorder handlers) consumed by WorkstationTabBar.

nodes.name: useWorkstationTabList
nodes.summary: Custom hook that derives the tab list for the current host, plus click/close/reorder/close-others/close-saved handlers, from workstation tab store state.

nodes.name: useWorkstationTrailingSlot.tsx
nodes.summary: Hook computing the trailing slot content (info button, new-session split button, dev tools/bottom panel toggles) shown at the right edge of the workstation tab bar.

nodes.name: useWorkstationTrailingSlot
nodes.summary: Custom hook that assembles host-specific trailing tab-bar controls (terminal info, new terminal session, dev tools toggle) based on the active tab list and visibility.

nodes.name: AgentEventBubbles.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders chat bubbles for Agent-Org events: send-message events and multi-step org task events, including recipient/title resolution logic.

nodes.name: isOrgTaskEvent
nodes.summary: Type-guard determining whether a session event represents a multi-step Agent-Org task (vs. a simple send-message).

nodes.name: resolveRecipientLabel
nodes.summary: Resolves a raw recipient identifier to a human-readable org member label for display in the bubble header.

nodes.name: Framed
nodes.summary: Internal presentational component wrapping bubble content in a consistent framed layout with sender name and icon.

nodes.name: resolveOrgTaskTitle
nodes.summary: Derives the display title for an org task event based on its subject, tool call payload, and translation strings.

nodes.name: OrgSendMessageBubble
nodes.summary: Chat bubble component rendering an Agent-Org send-message event with recipient and content.

nodes.name: OrgTaskEventBubble
nodes.summary: Chat bubble component rendering a multi-step Agent-Org task event with resolved title and status.

nodes.name: ChatBubble.tsx
nodes.summary: Core chat bubble component set for the Communication panel: renders todo lists, interaction widgets, plan cards, terminal/skill pills, and the main agent/user chat bubble.

nodes.name: renderCommunicationTodoLabel
nodes.summary: Formats a communication todo item's label for display, applying status-aware styling cues.

nodes.name: hasOpenCommunicationTodoBlockers
nodes.summary: Checks whether a todo item has unresolved blocking dependencies among the full todo list.

nodes.name: CommunicationTodoCheckbox
nodes.summary: Internal component rendering a checkbox/status indicator for a single communication todo row.

nodes.name: parseTerminalPills
nodes.summary: Parses embedded terminal-command markup out of message content into structured terminal pill data.

nodes.name: parseSkillPills
nodes.summary: Parses embedded skill-invocation markup out of message content into structured skill pill data.

nodes.name: resolveSkillFilePath
nodes.summary: Resolves a skill name to its installed skill file path for display/navigation in a skill pill.

nodes.name: AgentFramedBubble
nodes.summary: Shared internal wrapper component providing the framed layout (icon, sender, click handling) reused by TodoBubble, InteractionBubble, and PlanBubble.

nodes.name: TodoBubble
nodes.summary: Chat bubble component rendering an agent's todo-list update as a checklist card.

nodes.name: InteractionBubble
nodes.summary: Chat bubble component rendering an interactive widget event (approval/mode-switch/etc.) inline in the chat stream.

nodes.name: PlanBubble
nodes.summary: Chat bubble component rendering a plan-document event as a summary card in the chat stream.

nodes.name: ChatBubble
nodes.summary: Main chat bubble component that renders a standard agent or user message, including markdown content, terminal/skill pills, and streaming status.

nodes.name: EmailMessageBubble.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders email-tool events (send/draft/read) as an email-styled chat bubble with subject, recipients, and body preview.

nodes.name: isEmailBubbleEvent
nodes.summary: Type-guard determining whether a session event corresponds to one of the recognized email tool calls that should render as an EmailMessageBubble.

nodes.name: buildEmailMessageView
nodes.summary: Builds the view-model (subject, recipients, body, direction) for an email event from its raw tool call/result payload.

nodes.name: HeaderRow
nodes.summary: Internal presentational component rendering a single labeled header row (To/From/Subject) within the email bubble.

nodes.name: EmailMessageBubble
nodes.summary: Chat bubble component rendering an email tool event using the derived email view-model and header rows.

nodes.name: EmptyState.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the empty-state placeholder shown in the Communication message viewer when no messages exist yet.

nodes.name: EmptyState
nodes.summary: Function component displaying a placeholder message/icon when there are no chat messages, varying copy by session replay mode.

nodes.name: MessageViewer.tsx
nodes.summary: Main scrollable message list component for the Communication panel, grouping and rendering chat/todo/interaction/email/plan messages with virtualization-friendly batching.

nodes.name: shouldGroupWithPreviousMessage
nodes.summary: Determines whether a message should be visually grouped with the immediately preceding message (same sender, within the same minute bucket).

nodes.name: MessageViewer
nodes.summary: Top-level message list component that renders grouped chat bubbles, handles incremental load-more, plan preview/edit state, and dispatches to MessageBubbleRenderer/PlanDocPanel.

nodes.name: InteractionRenderers.tsx
nodes.summary: Renderer helpers that turn interaction/approval/mode-switch events and plan-doc cards into JSX for the message bubble renderer.

nodes.name: isApprovalEvent
nodes.summary: Type-guard checking whether an interaction event is an approval-request event.

nodes.name: isModeSwitchEvent
nodes.summary: Type-guard checking whether an interaction event is a mode-switch request event.

nodes.name: renderPlanDocCard
nodes.summary: Renders a plan-document summary card for a message using the plan-doc view model, given the current org member list.

nodes.name: replayEventInput
nodes.summary: Extracts the raw input payload from a replay interaction event for display.

nodes.name: renderInteractionWidget
nodes.summary: Dispatches an interaction message to the appropriate InteractionBubble rendering based on its event kind (approval, mode-switch, etc.).

nodes.name: MessageBubbleRenderer.tsx
nodes.summary: Dispatch layer that wraps each message entry with grouping/spacing chrome and renders the correct bubble component (chat, todo, email, org event, interaction) based on message kind.

nodes.name: NewMessageDivider
nodes.summary: Small divider component showing a labeled separator line between older and newer messages.

nodes.name: BubbleWrapper
nodes.summary: Component that wraps a single message entry, applies grouping-aware spacing, and dispatches to the correct bubble renderer (ChatBubble, TodoBubble, EmailMessageBubble, OrgSendMessageBubble/OrgTaskEventBubble, or interaction renderer) based on message type.

nodes.name: constants.ts
nodes.summary: Small constants module defining initial rendered message counts and the load-more page size used by MessageViewer's incremental rendering.

nodes.name: planDocViewModel.ts
nodes.summary: View-model helpers deriving plan-document status labels and adapter status from create_plan tool events and pending-plan state.

nodes.name: planSurfaceStatusLabel
nodes.summary: Maps a plan surface status enum to its translated display label.

nodes.name: getPlanDocStatusViewModel
nodes.summary: Derives the plan document's status view-model (label, tone) from the create_plan event and any locally pending plan state.

nodes.name: getPlanDocViewModel
nodes.summary: Builds the full plan-doc view-model (title, path, content, status) for a plan message, combining event data with pending-plan overrides.

nodes.name: planAdapterStatus
nodes.summary: Computes the adapter-facing status string for a plan event used by downstream plan approval components.

nodes.name: MessagesSidebar.tsx
nodes.summary: Left sidebar for the Communication app in Agent Station, showing aggregate filter rows for Messages/Todos/Interactions using PrimarySidebarLayout.

nodes.name: MessagesSidebar
nodes.summary: Memoized sidebar component rendering aggregate Messages/Todos/Interactions filter rows and wiring view-mode selection.

nodes.name: MessagesSidebarRows.tsx
nodes.summary: Aggregate filter row sub-components (Messages, Todos, Interactions) used by MessagesSidebar as a one-to-one mapping to each MessageViewMode.

nodes.name: AggregateMessagesRow
nodes.summary: Row component representing the aggregate 'Messages' filter entry with a count badge in the communication sidebar.

nodes.name: AggregateTodoRow
nodes.summary: Row component representing the aggregate 'Todos' filter entry with a count badge in the communication sidebar.

nodes.name: AggregateInteractionsRow
nodes.summary: Row component representing the aggregate 'Interactions' filter entry with a count badge in the communication sidebar.

nodes.name: PlanApprovalActions.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the edit/save/open-in-my-station action buttons shown beneath a plan document card for approving or editing a plan.

nodes.name: PlanApprovalActions
nodes.summary: Function component rendering edit-toggle, save, and open-in-my-station buttons for plan approval, with disabled/submitting states.

nodes.name: PlanDocPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the full plan document content panel (markdown viewer or edit textarea) with status label, used inside the plan preview surface.

nodes.name: PlanDocPanel
nodes.summary: Memoized component rendering plan document content either as a read-only markdown/CodeMirror viewer or an editable textarea depending on isPreviewMode/editState.
